name: khuym
description: Khuym: focused meta-skills for prompting, goal shaping, research, execution sequencing, and smart commits

interface.shortDescription: Portable meta-skills for stronger agent work
interface.longDescription: Five independent skills for improving prompts, shaping verifiable goals, researching unfamiliar work, sequencing dependencies, and organizing Git commits. No onboarding workflow or repository state machine is required.
defaultPrompt: Improve this rough prompt; if it is a goal, grill me until success and stop conditions are verifiable.
Research this unfamiliar feature, then sequence the recommendation by dependency and risk.
Group the current working tree into logical commits and push it.
